$comment: Percentages require evidence. VERIFIED requires evidence. UNMEASURED carries no number at all. Enforced by scripts/check-progress.mjs.
overallStatus: IN PROGRESS — deployed and working; core user journey not built

evidence: Discovery, matching and storage work end to end on the deployed stack (/api/health returns 3.0.0)
The core user journey is not built: CS-16 to CS-19 are all READY, none started
No user-facing feature has been validated from the user perspective
v2/apps/web builds, typechecks and lints clean
No shared loading, empty or error states (CS-13); Leads unusable on a phone (CS-14)
Known layout defect open at 768px on Linux WebKit (CS-2), fix written but unverified
Root suite 1047/1047 passing locally
v2 unit layer 33/33 passing in CI
Six v2 integration files need Postgres and Redis and run nowhere (CS-9)
13 tables and 13 applied migrations, with 18 CHECK constraints, 10 indexes and 2 composite foreign keys — the schema is substantially complete, not a sketch

Security review found search_jobs and run_events reference searches.id and users.id separately rather than a composite (owner_id, run_id) key, so a cross-owner row is representable at the database layer
v2/scripts/check-database-recovery.ts exists but no recovery run has been recorded, and no scheduled dump exists (CS-25)
Postings have no retention or liveness recheck (CS-27), and identity can merge two real openings (CS-28)
Deployed and serving: careerscope.tech/api/health returns 3.0.0
Deploy now refuses a commit CI rejected (CS-7), unverified in a live run
Managed firewall configured but NOT attached; no proxy self-healing (CS-3)

Security agent review 2026-09-19: all ten assessed areas IMPLEMENTED — Argon2id m=19456, session tokens stored only as SHA-256 with 8h expiry and fixation resistance, owner scoping enforced at the repository layer, origin plus timing-safe CSRF, helmet and Caddy headers, Zod strict validation at every boundary, magic-byte upload checks with 0600 files
No reachable cross-owner or injection path was found; publicLink rejects non-HTTPS and embedded credentials, and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML exists in v2/apps/web

Deduction is evidential: no security review had ever been recorded for v2 before this one, the v2 suite runs in no pipeline, and the live origin was not observed — these are code-level conclusions about a deployment that was not tested
Open gaps: auth and isolation tests never execute in CI (P1), non-composite FKs on search_jobs and run_events (P2), script-src unsafe-inline in the app CSP (P2)
Live /api/health measured 2026-09-19 from this machine: 196ms, 105ms, 91ms — the deployed origin responds, but this is one endpoint over the public internet, not a workload
v2/scripts/check-performance.ts exists and measures p95, concurrency, duration and request counts, so the capability is present
No performance result has ever been recorded in the progress evidence, and the check runs in no pipeline
Public payload measured: jobs.json is 0.54 MB across 2,529 rows and parses in 9ms; the rebuilt page ships 50 KB with the first 20 rows inlined
Nothing has been measured for the database, the queue, the workers or the browser, which is where this application would actually degrade
1047 root tests and 33 v2 unit tests pass; five gate suites proven by mutation
No database, queue or browser coverage runs in CI (CS-9)
CS-2 cannot be reproduced locally; only CI can adjudicate it
Architecture is documented and the V1/V2 split is recorded
No independent design review has been run this cycle
CS-6 records that frontend route architecture and the shared shell are inconsistent
No design pass on the public Pages surface (CS-11)
No accessibility baseline has ever been measured (CS-15)
Frontend agent now owns senior UI/UX; nothing has been implemented under it yet
The documentation set is extensive and the Copilot contract is current
Two documents asserted agents could not be invoked; disproved on 2026-09-19, so drift is demonstrated not hypothetical
Documentation now gates the release, but no release has passed that gate yet
lint 0, format 0, typecheck 0 across the workspace
Code Quality agent reviewed ONE file on 2026-09-19 and found duplication, unreadable-as-empty reads and a status-vocabulary defect
The previous 90% VERIFIED predated any review actually being run
